environmentalFactors.platform: Local development environment (Docker containerized NoSQL databases on host SSD)
environmentalFactors.hardwareNotes: Intel/AMD x86_64 CPU with single-node localhost network loopback (sub-0.1ms wire latency)
environmentalFactors.environmentalLimitations: Absolute milliseconds reflect local single-node hardware. Real-world multi-datacenter clusters will experience cross-rack network hops (1-5ms), disk fsync throttles, and concurrent connection pool queuing. Relative algorithmic orders of growth (O(1), O(log N), O(N), O(k)) remain valid.

results.description: Queries student by indexed studentId field using WiredTiger clustered B-Tree index.
results.notes: B-Tree logarithmic search O(log N). Highly efficient point seek on scale 5K (~5,000 docs).

results.description: Queries student by non-indexed regex pattern forcing full collection scan (COLLSCAN).
results.notes: Linear complexity O(N). Scans every document sequentially. Shows dramatic latency increase at scale 5K.

results.description: Multi-stage aggregation pipeline ($match -> $unwind -> $group -> $sort) analyzing department skills.
results.notes: WiredTiger aggregation pipeline with document deconstruction and accumulator aggregation at scale 5K.
Index-Free Adjacency: O(k) complexity proportional only to node degree k, invariant to global graph scale.

results.description: Traverses student skills to candidate courses sharing those skills: (:Student)->(:Skill)<-(:Course).
results.notes: Replaces 2-table relational join with direct pointer chaining.

results.description: Variable-length multi-hop traversal along prerequisite hierarchy: (:Skill)-[:SKILL_PREREQUISITE_OF*1..3]->(:Skill).
results.notes: Transitive closure evaluation without recursive SQL Common Table Expression (CTE) table scans.

results.description: Cypher shortestPath() algorithm finding the shortest dependency bridge between student and career goal.
results.notes: Bidirectional Breadth-First Search navigating pointer records natively.

results.description: Cypher query with pattern comprehension evaluating candidate courses against unacquired skills.
results.notes: Evaluates complex neighborhood overlaps and prerequisite satisfaction in a single graph transaction.

results.description: Direct in-memory point read from Redis dictionary bypassing disk I/O completely.
results.notes: O(1) hash map lookup. Serves responses in sub-millisecond latency directly from system RAM.

results.description: Request executes query against primary disk database without caching layer acceleration.
results.notes: Demonstrates baseline database latency when cache is bypassed, enduring query parsing and disk seek overhead.

results.description: Cache-aside lookup where requested key is present; returns cached object with zero database load.
results.notes: Fast path. Increments cache hit counter and returns pre-serialized data directly.

results.description: Cache-aside lookup where key is absent; executes primary fetch, serializes payload, and populates Redis.
results.notes: Slow path. Absorbs network trip to primary store before warming the cache for subsequent requests.

results.description: Point query targeting single partition key (student_id, activity_date) with LIMIT 1.
results.notes: Consistent hashing locates the target node directly using Murmur3 token; zero cluster broadcast.

results.description: Retrieves events within a partition sorted in reverse chronological order via clustering key.
results.notes: Sequential on-disk scan inside SSTable partition. Avoids in-memory sorting via CLUSTERING ORDER BY.

results.description: Scans large block of time-series event records from a single wide-column partition.
results.notes: Streams sequential rows from local SSTables. Memory overhead bounded by partition paging size.

results.description: Executes end-to-end multi-criteria scoring algorithm across student interests and course prerequisites.
results.notes: Combines Neo4j graph neighborhood queries, weighted scoring formula, and explanation generation.

results.description: Computes set difference and prerequisite deficit between student skill graph and target job ontology.
results.notes: Extracts missing required skills and evaluates readiness score percentage in application layer.

results.description: Topological sort over prerequisite DAG producing sequential: Current Skills -> Prerequisites -> Courses -> Job.
results.notes: Executes Kahn algorithm over skill dependency DAG ensuring zero cycle deadlocks.

fairComparisonMatrix.accessPattern: Point Entity Read by Unique Key
fairComparisonMatrix.whyBestFit: Redis resolves O(1) hash table keys in RAM (<1ms). MongoDB resolves indexed point queries in O(log N) B-Tree seeks (<5ms).
fairComparisonMatrix.whyUnsuitable: Graph engines impose relationship traversal overhead unnecessary for isolated single-entity lookups.

fairComparisonMatrix.whyBestFit: Index-Free Adjacency traverses direct double-linked memory pointers in O(k) time independent of global graph scale.
fairComparisonMatrix.whyUnsuitable: Document and SQL joins require nested foreign-key index scans O(N * log M), degrading exponentially beyond 2 hops.

fairComparisonMatrix.whyBestFit: Log-Structured Merge-Trees (LSM) append sequentially to CommitLog and Memtable with zero read-before-write or B-Tree page lock contention.
fairComparisonMatrix.whyUnsuitable: B-Tree node rebalancing and graph pointer index updates induce severe write amplification under continuous ingestion.

fairComparisonMatrix.accessPattern: Polymorphic Document Modeling with Dynamic Schemas
fairComparisonMatrix.whyBestFit: Hierarchical BSON documents store polymorphic entities with varying structures without requiring global DDL migrations.
fairComparisonMatrix.whyUnsuitable: Wide-column stores require query-driven strict primary keys and disallow ad-hoc field filtering outside declared indexes.
